text: The Patriots' 35-6 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday in Jacksonville has sparked serious questions about how the team is deploying Drake Maye, whose early-season struggles persisted with two interceptions and a lost fumble in the blowout defeat—a performance Maye himself labeled "unacceptable" as he looks inward for answers about both his own play and the offense's execution. Film breakdowns reveal defensive coverage splits and scheme issues that exposed New England's offense, while Jacksonville's response after a week of messaging from coach Liam Coen proved devastating, with Trevor Lawrence throwing three touchdown passes to lead the rout. The silver lining for New England came courtesy of cornerback Marcus Jones, who snagged his first interception of the season, offering at least one bright spot in an otherwise dismal day that's raising pointed discussions about whether the Patriots are maximizing their young quarterback's skill set.
